newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria buys 13,000 tonnes raw sugar, cancels whites.
newsitem.headline: Syria buys 13,000 tonnes raw sugar, cancels whites.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has bought 13,000 tonnes for raw sugar at $292.75 a tonne, a GEZA official said on Thursday.
He told Reuters the quantity would be delivered between 20 December 1996 and 20 January 1997.
The official said the sugar was bought from France's Lorico.
He said GEZA had cancelled a bid for 13,000 tonnes of white sugar which was part of the same tender, issued on November 5.
"Price offers did not meet GEZA's conditions," he added.
